As noted in last year's Directors' remuneration report, Timo was appointed Interim CEO in January 2022 having previously been the Senior Managing Director of our largest region, DACH (Germany, Austria and Switzerland). Timo brings a wealth of relevant experience in STEM recruitment, a deep understanding of our business, and focused, dynamic leadership, all vital qualities as the Group continues to execute its growth strategy.

Timo was appointed on a base salary of £483,900, which was the same level as the previous CEO, and his variable reward was aligned with the remuneration policy.
